source: Indian High Court Judgments open dataset (AWS Open Data; Dattam Labs; eCourts) — CC-BY-4.0
court: High Court of Punjab and Haryana
selection: CRM-M petitions (bail / quashing) by private parties vs State of Punjab/Haryana/UT Chandigarh, decided 2024-2025, random order

piiAudit.method: local Llama 3.1 8B asked to list any remaining personal names in each pseudonymised narrative
piiAudit.genuine: first name of a trial-court judge after 'Ms .' (PDF spacing) — fixed in the pseudonymisation rules (honorifics), records rebuilt
piiAudit.falsePositives: 4: role words (petitioner, complainant, Brother) and a police-station name — not applied
